request.state:
Target: Meta Platforms (META). Meta operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and related social products; advertising is a major business activity. It also develops virtual and augmented reality products.

Focal announcement: How AI Is Ushering in the Next Era of Risk Review at Meta.

Decision cutoff: 2026-03-31T23:59:59-04:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: How AI Is Ushering in the Next Era of Risk Review at Meta. Published: 2026-03-31. URL: https://about.fb.com/news/2026/03/how-ai-is-ushering-in-the-next-era-of-risk-review-at-meta.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: At Meta, we’re seeing AI advancements transform every segment of our work. This translates to better, safer products for the billions of people who use our services every day. With the rapid advancements in AI, we’re fundamentally rethinking our approach to meeting this commitment and we’re transforming our product Privacy Review into a broader, cross-company Risk Review program with AI at its core. Before a new product or feature even pops up on your smartphone, computer or wearable device, teams at Meta complete a robust risk review, a process that identifies and mitigates potential privacy, safety, and security concerns, and helps ensure the product complies with applicable legal requirements. And we’re seeing this broader shift across the industry, as companies build on privacy programs to develop more integrated, multi-domain risk management approaches — a topic that Data Protection Officers across the industry will discuss at the IAPP Global Summit.

The exact historical text version is unverified. This is an incomplete source-based reconstruction.

These are coarse descriptions computed from observed historical inputs. Strong past movement or relative strength is not evidence that the next return must continue or reverse.

The previously fitted market-only reference model favored an upward return beyond the neutral band. Its leading outcome was favored, with meaningful uncertainty. It still assigned meaningful possibility to a return inside the narrow neutral band and a downward return beyond the neutral band. This is a training-only model forecast, not an observed outcome or independent news evidence.

The neutral return band's half-width is much narrower than the code-computed ordinary five-session variability scale. An irrelevant article does not eliminate ordinary price movement; this is not a calculated class probability.

Forecast target: entry is the first regular-session open after the cutoff; exit is the fifth session close, counting entry as session one. Raw return above +1% is up; within inclusive -1% to +1% is flat; below -1% is down. The initial pre-entry reaction is outside this target.

Do not invent analyst consensus, incremental target sales, new corporate cash payments, or an already-priced news reaction.
